name: Scrapbook Resume Site
description: Turn a creative professional's resume into a responsive portfolio site with a lanyard-style profile badge, paper-like project previews, cobalt highlights, and clear career history.
whatYouGet: Responsive resume homepage with a distinctive profile badge
Editable project previews and career timeline
Accessible navigation, contact action, and optional resume download
Self-contained HTML ready to adapt to a frontend framework
goodFit: Independent designers presenting selected work and experience
Creative founders who need a personal site with a clear contact path
Editors or art directors balancing personality with credentials
notFor: Sites bound to an existing corporate design system
requiredInputs: Name, role, location, and contact address
Biography and work history with dates
Project titles, descriptions, and available images or links
Optional resume file and social profiles

faq.q: Can I edit the resume after delivery?
faq.a: Yes. Names, dates, project descriptions, links, and contact details are standard page content rather than text embedded in images.

faq.q: What happens if I do not have project images?
faq.a: The page uses clearly labeled typographic project previews. Real images can replace them later without changing the content structure.

faq.q: Does the site need a hosting service?
faq.a: The self-contained HTML can be published on any host that serves static files. Hosting and a domain are not included.

demoPrompt: /sl-scrapbook-resume-site Create a responsive portfolio and resume for fictional Portland independent brand designer Tavi Mercer, for prospective clients. In order: navigation, stacked hero, three selected projects, about with three bullets, three quick stats, three capabilities, reverse-chronological experience, project inquiry CTA, footer. Quote “Tavi Mercer” and “Have a project in mind?” Keep the Cobalt Field Notes scrapbook style.
followUpPrompts: Add a project detail page using the same badge and paper-block visual language.
Replace the placeholder previews with these images and preserve their captions.
Make the experience timeline more compact on mobile.
externalCostNote: No external services. Runs entirely on your agent.
